Gen Leasing Activity Continues to be Strong
1,100,000 SF of Leases Signed to Date in Third Quarter
Includes over 200,000 SF of New Leases
Closes $74 Million of Non-Core Dispositions
RALEIGH, N.C., Sept. 14, 2026
Highwoods Properties, Inc.

announced it has signed 1,100,000 square feet of second generation leases since July 1, 2026, including over 200,000 square feet of new leases. This activity includes several long-term renewals with large customers across multiple markets.
Ted Klinck, President and Chief Executive Officer, stated, “

Our leasing activity continues to be strong with over 1.1 million square feet of second gen deals signed during the first two months of the quarter and a healthy leasing pipeline of new and renewal prospects. With the lack of new supply currently under construction and dwindling blocks of high-quality space available in the BBDs of our markets, we continue to drive occupancy and rents higher while reducing our near-term lease rollover risk.

The Company has also closed two previously announced non-core sales aggregating $73.5 million. First, the Company has sold six non-core office buildings encompassing 472,000 square feet in the Innsbrook submarket of Richmond. Second, the Company has sold a 118,000 square foot non-core office building in Century Center in Atlanta. With these sales, to date in 2026, the Company has sold a total of 11 non-core office buildings encompassing 1,461,000 square feet and 10 acres of joint venture-owned development land for an aggregate of $374.8 million that were projected to generate, on a combined basis, $30.1 million of annual cash net operating income and $30.3 million of annual GAAP net operating income in 2026.
About Highwoods
Highwoods Properties, Inc., headquartered in Raleigh, is a publicly-traded

, fully-integrated office real estate investment trust (“REIT”) that owns, develops, acquires, leases and manages properties primarily in the best business districts (BBDs) of Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Nashville, Orlando, Raleigh and Tampa. Our vision is to be a leader in the evolution of commercial real estate for the benefit of our customers, our communities and those who invest with us. Our mission is to create environments and experiences that inspire our teammates and our customers to achieve more together. We are in the work-placemaking business and believe that by creating exceptional environments and experiences, we can deliver greater value to our customers, their teammates and, in turn, our shareholders.
